screenLocation.rationale: Upload targets an existing session, so it needs a sessionId. The review route is the only per-session screen and already carries sessionId; the create screen has no sessionId until after save. The section renders only when draft === 'none' (no AI draft yet) and sttMode is 'local' or 'azure'.

screenLocation.contents: status line (engine unset / agent not connected / can upload), file input (accept=AUDIO_ACCEPT), progress line ('올리는 중' + live WireEmpty), receipt line ('녹음을 받았습니다. 다음 영업일 처리 기회부터 전사됩니다…' — server-fixed wording, no invented date), denial line, safety note (deleted right after processing; unmasked original leaves to external STT on the azure route).
